subject: National literals
notes: cite.py --check 8.3.3.5.4 "If character-1 is not specified, the literal is a zero-length literal" -> OK (rule 3). Zero length: IsZeroLength tests the body structurally; probe p1 LENGTH(N"")=0 (also conformance:2002/pb425_zero_length_literal_move moves N""). a) compile-time value: source is decoded as UTF-8 into UTF-16 (the D-N1 national compile-time set); probe p1 N"\u00e9x" LENGTH=2 and N"\u00e9\u6f22" displays unchanged. b) runtime conversion (§8.1.2): compile-time and runtime national sets are both UTF-16, so the conversion is the identity - the covering test asserts a U+03A9 national literal round-trips. Both halves verified by probe. [editions as adjudicated: COBOL-2002, COBOL-2014, COBOL-2023 (national literals are a COBOL-2002 introduction; absent from COBOL-85, where the construct is rejected COBOL0900 via Constructs.NationalData2002)]
